Your data can be accessed by us for any reason (see Franchise Agreement Section 11(j)).

We will have 14 days after receipt of information and materials we require from you to approve

or disapprove the proposed site as the location for the Franchised Business. If we do not disapprove a proposed site by written notice to you within this time period, the site will be deemed disapproved.

Your Franchise Agreement may be terminated if, for any reason, you or your Operating Principal do not successfully complete the Initial Training Program to our satisfaction within 120 days after you sign your Franchise Agreement.

All executive, administrative and marketing personnel employed by you in the Franchised Business must successfully complete the Initial Training Program within 90 days following the date on which they commence work. We may approve you to provide the Initial Training to these individuals.
You must pay us a Subsequent Initial Training Fee of $500 per person or our then-current fee for such training, before the beginning of any such Subsequent Initial Training Program

Provide to you in writing, or through our Manuals, or through other materials as we deem appropriate, our standards and specifications for certain items in your Franchised Business such as your insurance, trademarked materials, vehicles and uniforms and products and services you must offer.
